description: A full splat on an empty list gives an empty list of the attribute's type
notes: The spec doesn't give the result type of a splat over a list or set; it only says splats are approximately equivalent to for expressions, which produce tuples. hashicorp/hcl produces a list when the source is a list or a set (SplatExpr.Value in hclsyntax/expression.go). The element type string comes from applying the traversal to an unknown value of the list's element type (the resultTy closure in SplatExpr.Value), which the spec doesn't describe.
